description: Na₃Si₃N₅ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.60 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.53 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.90 Å. There are three inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four N atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SiN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Si-N bond distances ranging from 1.73-1.80 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four N atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing SiN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Si-N bond distances ranging from 1.71-1.80 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four N atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SiN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Si-N bond distances ranging from 1.69-1.84 Å. There are five inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and three Si atoms. In the second N site, N is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two Si atoms. In the third N site, N is bonded to four Na and two equivalent Si atoms to form edge-sharing NNa₄Si₂ octahedra. In the fourth N site, N is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and three Si atoms. In the fifth N site, N is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and two Si atoms.
